spec.description:
FI32 Semi-Rigid Insulation is a versatile glasswool board and
roll insulation engineered for thermal and acoustic performance in HVAC and
industrial systems. Designed for internal lining of sheet metal air conditioning
ductwork, it is also widely used on storage tanks, process vessels, plant rooms,
and acoustic baffles. Manufactured from up to 80% recycled glass with an FBS-1
bio-soluble formulation, it is available unfaced or factory-laminated with
Sisalation Heavy Duty Perforated foil, Black Matt Facing, or Vapastop 883.
features:
Nominal density of 32 kg/m³ providing superior structural
rigidity and acoustic absorption

Excellent sound absorption with NRC values
up to 1.00 in ductwork and plant rooms

Available unfaced or with Vapastop 883, Sisalation HDP foil, or Black
Matt Facing
Non-combustible glasswool substrate compliant with AS 1530.1
Manufactured in Australia from up to 80% recycled glass

Accommodates flat
and curved surfaces on tanks and vessels

Certified under CodeMark Certificate
of Conformity CM 30006

Biosoluble safe-to-use FBS-1 formulation with low VOC
emissions

technical.value: 25 mm, 38 mm, 50 mm, 66 mm, 75 mm, 100 mm
Ignitability: 0, Spread of Flame: 0, Heat Evolved: 0, Smoke Developed: 0-1

spec.fire:
Non-combustible base to AS 1530.1; AS/NZS 1530.3
indices: Ignitability: 0, Spread of Flame: 0, Heat Evolved: 0, Smoke
Developed: 0-1; Meets AS 4254 ductwork fire requirements
spec.compliance:
AS/NZS 4859.1, AS 4254 (Ductwork for air-handling systems), CodeMark CM 30006,
NCC 2022 Volume 1 & 2
spec.sustainability:
Manufactured from up to 80% recycled
glass; FBS-1 bio-soluble formulation; zero ODP; low VOC
install:
Clean
internal sheet metal duct or vessel surface ensuring it is free of oil and
dust

Cut FI32 sheets or rolls accurately to fit internal duct dimensions
using a sharp insulation knife

Apply approved water-based or solvent-based
duct liner adhesive covering 100% of the metal surface

Press FI32 firmly into
the wet adhesive with facing material exposed to the air stream

Fasten with
mechanical weld pins or grip nails at recommended spacings per AS 4254

Seal
all leading edges, transverse joints, and longitudinal seams with Vapastop 883
tape or edge-seal mastic

For curved vessels or tanks, wrap sheets or rolls
tightly and secure with metal banding straps
selection_checklist:
Confirm application (internal duct lining vs tank/vessel lagging vs plant room
acoustic wall)

Select facing material (unfaced, Sisalation HDP perforated
foil, Black Matt Facing, or Vapastop 883)

Determine required R-value and
thickness (25mm R0.71 up to 100mm R3.0) per AS 4254 / NCC energy tables
Choose sheet or roll format based on duct dimensions and fabrication machinery
accessories:
Mechanical
weld pins and speed clips
limitations:
Maximum
continuous operating temperature for facing materials is 120°C (unfaced
glasswool operates up to 340°C)

Black Matt Facing (BMF) is unsuitable for
mechanical brush cleaning inside ducts

Not designed for external weather
exposure without protective sheet metal cladding

retrieval.rag_summary:
Fletcher FI32 Semi-Rigid
Insulation is a 32 kg/m³ high-density glasswool board and roll insulation
engineered for internal HVAC duct lining and industrial vessel lagging.
Delivering superior sound absorption (NRC up to 1.00) and thermal conductivity
of 0.032 W/m·K, it is available unfaced or with Sisalation HDP perforated foil,
Black Matt Facing, or Vapastop 883 vapour barrier. CodeMark certified (CM 30006)
and non-combustible to AS 1530.1, it dampens air turbulence, fan noise, and heat
transfer in commercial ductwork and plant rooms.
